maddeler.e:
أستنهض (form X)
# أَسْتَنْهِضُ (ʔastanhiḍu) /ʔas.tan.hi.dˤu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَنْهَضَ (istanhaḍa)
# أَسْتَنْهِضَ (ʔastanhiḍa) /ʔas.tan.hi.dˤa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَنْهَضَ (istanhaḍa)
# أَسْتَنْهِضْ (ʔastanhiḍ) /ʔas.tan.hidˤ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَنْهَضَ (istanhaḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
